connector.name: RAWThink
connector.registryDescription: Persistent memory for AI thinking partnerships: hybrid search and a temporal knowledge graph.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package rawthink-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ygtalp account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: RAWTHINK_VAULT
env.description: Path to the vault directory holding sessions, qnotes and the knowledge graph.

env.name: QDRANT_PATH
env.description: Set to a directory to run Qdrant embedded instead of via Docker.

env.name: OLLAMA_URL
env.description: Ollama server URL. Without it, retrieval degrades to sparse-only.

env.name: OLLAMA_MODEL
env.description: Embedding model. Changing it requires a full reindex.

env.name: RAWTHINK_TOOL_PROFILE
env.description: Which tools to expose: recall (4, read-only), record (5, the write path), or full (17).

env.name: RAWTHINK_BM25_STATE
env.description: Path to the BM25 state file. Defaults to <vault>/.bm25_state.json.

env.name: RAWTHINK_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log level for diagnostics on stderr.
